pipeline: T1.1 Genome Mask & Fill — Full Corrected Cascade (2026-07-02)
fixes_applied: A: DNABERT-2 loaded via AutoModelForMaskedLM(trust_remote_code=True) with CPU-safe attention (attention_probs_dropout_prob=0.1 override); previous run mis-loaded ~all transformer weights as random init via generic BertForMaskedLM.

B: L3/L5/L6b restricted to frame-valid entries (_w0 windows + 2 legacy GeneBreaker sequences); non-w0 windows are not codon-aligned to the true CDS and are reported as r_L1-only (router_handling=frame_unresolved_no_atg_start).

C: r_L5 pathogen-pathway prior now driven by organisms_manifest_v2.json (bsl / select_agent / cdc_category / who_priority / negative_control) instead of a 3-substring name match that could only ever fire for 2/542 genomes.

D: r_L5 replaced manifest-driven pathogen-pathway prior with Jaccard(WT_apo_pocket, filled_apo_pocket) via ESMFold+fpocket (ligand-free, since T3.1's ligand-docking pocket method only has curated ligands for 9 druggable targets, none overlapping T1.1's 542-genome panel). Threshold 0.30. Former manifest-driven prior retained as r_L5_pathway_aux_score (non-scoring).
